definition.en: An AI system or a coordinated set of AI systems that can perceive and act upon their environment, with a degree of autonomy, using tools as needed to achieve specific goals and adapt to changing inputs and contexts.

usage.en: An AI agent is an AI system, so all properties of AI system apply. Use has interface for how the agent is invoked, uses service and uses software for what the agent calls, and has component for the AI systems that form the agent. The definition follows a proposal and may change.

definition.en: A machine-based system that is designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment, and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.

usage.en: The provider of an AI system and the provider of the machine learning model it uses can be different organisations.

definition.en: An access point through which an AI agent can be invoked, with its protocol binding and security scheme. It is a specialisation of Data Service, so the endpoint URL, conformance to a standard, access rights and endpoint description are inherited.

usage.en: An A2A Agent Card describes the agent and all of its interfaces. Link the card once from the AI agent with has native description, and not from each interface.

definition.en: A feature or protocol extension that an AI agent supports.

usage.en: A capability describes how the agent can be used, not what it can do. The AgentCapabilities of an A2A Agent Card map to this class. What the agent can do is described with skill. Examples are streaming, push notifications and an extension of the A2A protocol.

definition.en: The architecture that represents the set of hardware, software, network resources and services required for the operation of an IT environment.
A notification given to people that they are interacting with an AI system.

usage.en: Declared by the provider for AI systems that interact directly with natural persons (AI Act, Article 50(1)). A system can have several disclosures, each with its own channel, wording and timing. Information that is only available in terms of use, URLs or documentation is not a disclosure in this sense. The labelling duties of deployers under Article 50(3) and (4) and the marking of outputs under Article 50(2) are not described by this class.

definition.en: A physical embodiment of the machine learning model in a particular format.
The combination of the probability of an occurrence of harm and the severity of that harm.
Software that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide context and capabilities to AI agents.

usage.en: Use this class for every MCP server, whether it is hosted or launched locally. A hosted server is reached through a Data Service, which gives the endpoint URL and is linked to the server with is implemented by. A server launched locally over stdio has no Data Service and needs no endpoint URL. One server can have several Data Services. Use conforms to on the Data Service to state the version of the MCP specification.

definition.en: A file that has been trained to recognize certain types of patterns.
The distinct format of structure of input or output data.
An ability that an AI agent offers.

usage.en: A skill describes what the agent can do for its callers. Skills of an A2A Agent Card, or of an OASF record, map to this class. A skill is not a protocol feature such as streaming or push notifications; these are described with has capability of the AI agent.

definition.en: The part of an electronic information system which consists of computer code.

usage.en: Software is the code, for example an application, a script, an interpreter or a library. A running instance of it that can be called is described as Data Service. Software that an AI agent executes is linked with uses software; software installed on an infrastructure is linked with has software.

definition.en: The Union assurance level that the cloud computing service is declared to meet.

usage.en: Applies only to services that are cloud computing services under the Cloud and AI Development Act. It is not a quality rating of other data services, such as MCP servers or agent interfaces. The level is declared by the provider; where a level requires certification, check the declaration against the certificate. Use a controlled vocabulary of the levels.

definition.en: The degree of autonomy with which the AI system operates.
The form in which the disclosure is perceived by people.

usage.en: Possible values are text, audio and visual, as in the Commission guidelines on Article 50 (C/2026/6005, point 37). Give every channel that is used; a disclosure with several channels is multimodal.

definition.en: The classification of the modality.
The date the data was originally collected, given by the uploader.
A specific goal that the AI agent is designed to achieve.

usage.en: May be omitted for general-purpose agents that have no single goal. The purpose of the system as a whole is given with intended use.

definition.en: The use for which the AI system is intended by its provider.
The wording of the information as it is shown or spoken to people.

usage.en: Provide the text actually presented, with a language tag, and not a link to a document. Terms of use alone are not sufficient (Commission guidelines, point 38). The notice should be in a language the audience understands (guidelines, point 142). Omit only when the disclosure has no wording, for example a persistent icon (guidelines, point 37).

definition.en: The date on which the AI system was first made available on the market.

usage.en: A system that is only used by its provider is not placed on the market; use put into service date for it.

definition.en: The protocol binding or transport used by the interface.

usage.en: Examples are JSON-RPC, gRPC and HTTP+JSON.

definition.en: The date on which the AI system was first supplied to a deployer, or put into use for the provider's own use, in accordance with its intended purpose.

usage.en: A system that is used only by its provider, as is common for research agents, is put into service without being placed on the market. Give this date, the placed on market date, or both, as applicable.

definition.en: The kind of authentication scheme needed to call the interface.

usage.en: Use a controlled vocabulary of authentication schemes, for example API key, HTTP bearer, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect or mutual TLS. For an A2A interface the values correspond to the security schemes of the Agent Card; a remote MCP server typically uses OAuth 2.0 or an API key. This property tells how to authenticate; who may access the service is given with access rights. Do not record secrets, tokens or credentials.

definition.en: The maximum size of the modality.
A protocol-level feature that the MCP server supports.

usage.en: Examples are tools, resources and prompts. The protocol features of an AI agent, such as the A2A streaming or push notifications, are described with has capability of the AI agent. The use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended.

definition.en: The moment at which the information is given to people.

usage.en: Possible values are first interaction, periodic and on request. A system should have at least one disclosure given at the latest at the first interaction (AI Act, Article 50(5); Commission guidelines, points 40 and 143). Periodic and on request describe additional disclosures.

definition.en: The transport used to reach the MCP server.

usage.en: Examples are streamable HTTP and the deprecated HTTP with Server-Sent Events. A server launched locally as a process of the AI agent uses the stdio transport and has no Data Service. The use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended.

definition.en: The url of the file to be downloaded.
A legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource.
A spatial region or named place.
A standard or other specification to which a resource conforms.

usage.en: It could be used, for example, to point directly to a Croissant file. In alignment with STATDCAT-AP #25

definition.en: A value that allows the contents of a file to be authenticated.

usage.en: This class allows the results of a variety of checksum and cryptographic message digest algorithms to be represented.

definition.en: Algorithm for Checksums.
rdfs:Literal encoded using the relevant [[ISO8601]] Date and Time compliant string and typed using the appropriate XML Schema datatype (xsd:gYear, xsd:gYearMonth, xsd:date, or xsd:dateTime).

NOTE$ea_notes=A literal value such as a string or integer; Literals may be typed, e.g. as a date according to xsd:date. Literals that contain human-readable text have an optional language tag as defined by BCP 47[[rfc5646]].
Anything described by RDF.
Hex-encoded binary data. The ï¿½value spaceï¿½ of hexBinary is the set of finite-length sequences of binary octets.
An idea or notion; a unit of thought.
A collection of operations that provides access to one or more datasets or data processing functions.
A conceptual entity that represents the information published.

usage.en: If a Dataset is used as part of a Dataset Series, the usage of the properties listed below must be coherent with the associated Dataset Series. For this usage, consult the guidelines in section 14. General usage guidelines.

definition.en: A spatial object that in a human-readable way identifies a fixed location.
A non-empty group of Permissions and/or Prohibitions.
Any entity carrying out actions with respect to the entities Catalogue and the Catalogued Resources.

usage.en: If the Agent is an organisation, the use of the Organization Ontology is recommended.

definition.en: A textual resource intended for human consumption that contains information, e.g. a web page about a Dataset.
A repository is a place where code and data is stored.
A capability that the AI agent supports.

usage.en: The AgentCapabilities of an A2A Agent Card map to this relation. The skills of the agent are described with has skill. Examples are streaming, push notifications and an extension of the A2A protocol.

definition.en: An AI system that is part of the coordinated set of AI systems forming the AI agent.
A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body using the AI system under its authority, except where it is used in the course of a personal non-professional activity.
A disclosure by which the AI system informs people that they are interacting with an AI system.

usage.en: Relevant for systems that interact directly with natural persons (AI Act, Article 50(1)).

definition.en: A natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the provider or the importer, that makes an AI system available on the Union market.
The file in which the model is expressed.
A file stored in the repository.
A natural or legal person located or established in the Union that places on the market an AI system bearing the name or trademark of a person established in a third country.
The entity that operates the computer infrastructure.

usage.en: An example is a cloud computing service provider.

definition.en: The modality of the input of the model.
The modality of the input that the AI agent can perceive.
An interface through which the AI agent can be invoked.
The agent that designs, develops or maintains the software.

usage.en: The CADA proposal asks audited providers to state where and by whom the software is designed, developed and maintained.

definition.en: A document in which the AI agent is described in its native format.

usage.en: An A2A Agent Card describes the agent and all of its interfaces, so it is linked once from the agent and not from every interface. The checksum of the file allows harvesters to detect changes of the card. An agent can have several native descriptions, for example an A2A Agent Card and an OASF record.

definition.en: The modality of the output that the AI agent can produce.
The modality of the output of the model.

A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops a Machine Learning Model or places it on the market or puts the it into service under its own name or trademark, whether for payment or free of charge.
A natural or legal person, public authority, agency or other body that develops the AI system or has it developed and places it on the market or puts it into service under its own name or trademark.
The registered user associated to the model.
The repository associated.
The repository associated.
A repository in which the software is made available.

usage.en: Examples are a source code repository and a package registry. The same software can be available in several repositories.

definition.en: A possible risk that can occur.
A possible risk that can occur.
A skill that the AI agent offers.

usage.en: The skills of an A2A Agent Card map to this relation.

definition.en: The software associated with the computer infrastructure.

usage.en: Can be used for the list of dependencies that audited providers make available to the auditing organisation under the CADA proposal.

definition.en: An entity responsible for uploading the resource.
The computer infrastructure on which the AI system runs.
The software that implements the data service.

usage.en: Links a data service to the software that runs it, for example an MCP server, a container image or a package. The same software can be described with its repository and licence. An MCP server that is only launched locally has no data service and is described as MCP Server alone.

definition.en: A model that this data service can distribute.
The training dataset used to train the machine learning model.
A dataset that the AI system uses at run time.

usage.en: An example is a knowledge base for retrieval.

definition.en: A machine learning model used by the AI system.
A data service that the AI agent can call.

usage.en: Examples are the Data Service of an MCP server and a REST API. The interfaces through which the agent itself is invoked are described with has interface.

definition.en: Software that the AI agent executes or invokes to perform tasks.

usage.en: Examples are a command-line program, a script and an interpreter. Not to be confused with has software of the computer infrastructure, which lists the software installed on the infrastructure.

definition.en: An object property linking something to the funding that funds it (i.e. that finances or pays for it), or to the funding agency providing that funding.  This flexibility is given because of alternative usages of the English word 'funds'.
Information about who can access the interface.
A standard or other specification to which the AI system conforms.

usage.en: For example a harmonised standard or a common specification (AI Act, Articles 40 and 41).

definition.en: A standard or specification, including its version, that the interface conforms to.
An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.
An entity responsible for making contributions to the dataset.
Date of creation of the resource.
An entity responsible for producing the Dataset.
An entity responsible for making the resource.
An entity responsible for making the resource.
A free-text account of the software.
A free-text account of the Dataset.

usage.en: This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the description.

definition.en: An account of the resource.
A free-text account of the AI system.
A free-text account of the skill.
A free-text account of the capability.
The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.
An unambiguous identifier for the resource.
A unique identifier of the AI system.
An identifier of the skill.

usage.en: An A2A skill identifier is only unique within one Agent Card. Read it together with the AI agent that offers the skill.

definition.en: An unambiguous identifier for the resource.
An identifier of the capability.

usage.en: An example is the URI of an A2A extension. Built-in features, such as streaming, have no identifier.

definition.en: The licence under which the resource is made available.
A licence under which the AI system is made available.
A licence under which the software is made available.

usage.en: Use a standard licence identifier, for example an SPDX identifier.

definition.en: An entity (organisation) responsible for making the resource available.
A geographical area in which the AI system has been placed on the market, put into service or made available.

usage.en: Use the Member States of the Countries authority table to state where the AI system is available. For high-risk AI systems, the AI Act asks for the Member States in which the system has been placed on the market, put into service or made available (Annex VIII, Section A).

definition.en: The name of the software.
The name assigned to the resource.
A name given to the Dataset.

usage.en: This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

definition.en: The name assigned to the resource.
A name associated to the risk.
The name assigned to the resource.
The name of the AI system.
The name of the skill.
A name given to the Data Service.

usage.en: This property can be repeated for parallel language versions of the name.

definition.en: The name assigned to the resource.
The name of the capability.

usage.en: An example is streaming.

definition.en: The algorithm used to produce the subject Checksum.

usage.en: The members of this property are the supported checksum algorithms.

definition.en: A mechanism that can be used to verify that the contents of a distribution have not changed.
A lower case hexadecimal encoded digest value produced using a specific algorithm.
The status of the AI system with regard to its availability on the market or in service.

usage.en: The recommended values follow the status listed for the registration of high-risk AI systems (AI Act, Annex VIII, Section A). The status complements the placed on market date and the put into service date.

definition.en: A description of the services available via the end-points.

usage.en: An example is the native Agent Card of an A2A agent.

definition.en: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (an IRI).
A keyword or tag describing the AI system.
A keyword or tag describing the skill.

usage.en: A2A tags of a skill map to this property.

definition.en: A web page that gives access to the AI system and to additional information about it.

usage.en: The AI Act registration of high-risk AI systems asks for a URL for additional information (Annex VIII, Section A).

definition.en: A collection of data that this data service can distribute.
A main category or application domain of the AI system.

usage.en: The use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended, for example the OASF domains. Record the version of the vocabulary.

definition.en: A main category of the skill.

usage.en: The use of a controlled vocabulary is recommended, for example the OASF skills taxonomy. Record the version of the vocabulary.

definition.en: The version of the software.
The current version of the model.
The version of the AI system.
The postal address of the agent.
The name of the uppermost level of the address, almost always a country.
The name of a secondary level/region of the address, usually a county, state or other such area that typically encompasses several localities.
The code created and maintained for postal purposes to identify a subdivision of addresses and postal delivery points.
A name created and maintained for postal purposes to identify a subdivision of addresses and postal delivery points.
The name of a passage or way through from one location to another.
A policy expressing permissions, prohibitions or obligations on the use of the AI system.
Delegation is the assignment of authority and responsibility to an agent (by itself or by another agent) to carry out a specific activity as a delegate or representative.

usage.en: It can include a software agent that for example can generate a dataset but also, a person as authorised representative of providers of general-purpose AI models or of high-risk AI systems. The authorised representative is the Agent that acted on behalf of the provider.

definition.en: The e-mail address of the agent.

usage.en: Use a mailto: URI (RFC 6068).

definition.en: A name of the agent.

usage.en: This property can be repeated for different versions of the name (e.g. the name in different languages).

definition.en: A page or document about the AI system.

usage.en: Use it for documents such as the electronic instructions for use and the EU declaration of conformity, which are part of the AI Act registration of high-risk AI systems (Annex VIII, Section A).

definition.en: The telephone number of the agent.

usage.en: Use a tel: URI (RFC 3966).
